## Welcome to MATH 40604A!! {.unnumbered}

Welcome, and congratulations on starting a new term. 
The purpose of this course is to give you the mathematical and
statistical background you need to feel comfortable in the rest of your
program. We will review and build up on the following topics: modelling, linear algebra, functions, calculus, optimization, probability, and statistical inference. That is a wide territory to cover but you will find yourself familiar with some of the material.
The course is new this year, and by the end of the term,
mathematical notation should feel more readable rather than intimidating.

You are welcome to look through the [course outline](https://khaledfouda.github.io/MATH40604/outline.html)
to see what each session covers.

### How the course works {.unnumbered}

Because there is a big ground to cover, part of the reading will
happen at home before class. Every week, I will upload two pre-class documents, one containing the notes and the other containing some exercises (with solutions provided). I have tried to make both as easy to follow as I can. If a topic gives you
trouble, please do not spend hours on it. Make a note of it  and we will go over it together during class. 

### Before our first session {.unnumbered}

Our first class is Monday, August 24th at 8:30–11:30. I know that is early in
the term, but I would be very grateful if you took a look at the Week 1 material  [Week 1 - Modelling, sets, and algebra](https://khaledfouda.github.io/MATH40604/weeks/w01/index.html)

Until then, enjoy what is left of the break and get some rest. I am looking
forward to meeting you all.

~ Khaled
